sandbox_note: This run executed inside a permission sandbox whose auto-mode classifier blocks any action it judges 'Irreversible Local Destruction/Deletion' - this fired on wp_delete_post (fixture cleanup), wp eval with $wpdb writes, and browser clicks on Delete/moderation actions. As a result this pass is READ-ONLY/OBSERVATIONAL for anything that creates, edits, votes, submits, approves, merges, deletes, or changes a setting. Every such row is in untested[] with this reason. Sections A/C-anon/C-admin-render/D-code-verifiable/E2-render/F-render were walked live in the browser or verified by direct code read; QA- prefixed fixture cleanup could not be run (classifier blocked wp_delete_post), so pre-existing stray QA fixtures ('regress...', 'QA repro title...') remain in the environment and were visible but not counted as new findings.

hard_fails.actual: OPEN, confirmed still present in code as instructed: product-roadmap/includes/class-roadmap-changelog.php line 1004 defaults $product_slug = 'general' and only overrides it from $postarr['tax_input']['roadmap_product'] (lines 1005-1009). The surrounding comment (lines 992-997) documents that the block editor's REST save publishes before the product taxonomy term is attached, so on that first save pass tax_input is empty and the slug is derived as 'general-v{version}' instead of '{product}-v{version}'. Live re-publish repro was not performed (would require creating a new changelog post, a write action blocked by the sandbox), but the cited root cause is unchanged from the card - do not mark this fixed.

top3: D.13 confirmed still OPEN: block-editor changelog publish under a non-default product still writes a 'general-' slug instead of '{product}-v{version}' - class-roadmap-changelog.php:1004 still defaults to 'general' before the product taxonomy term is attached on the REST save pass. Frontend roadmap board has no way to reach dark mode: RoadmapHeader.vue declares a toggle-dark-mode emit but no template element ever fires it, so App.vue's darkMode ref (line 297) can never flip from its default false. Every board view (board/list/cards/minimal/timeline/poll) is permanently light-only on the frontend regardless of D.5's admin-side fix.

This QA site's 5 named view pages (board-view, timeline-view, list-view, cards-view, minimal-view) are children of the Poll Roadmap page (post_parent=17), so direct requests 301-redirect to /poll-roadmap/<slug>/ instead of the 200 A1 asks for. Confirmed via code read that neither plugin creates these pages (only the setup wizard creates one top-level page) - this is QA fixture content, not a plugin bug, but the fixture site should be fixed so A1 reads clean next time.

failures.triage_note: product-roadmap and roadmap-pro-addon contain no wp_insert_post call that creates board-view/poll-roadmap/timeline-view/list-view/cards-view/minimal-view pages (grepped both repos - zero matches; the only page-creating code is the Free setup wizard's create_roadmap_page() which makes exactly one top-level page). These 5 pages were manually set up on this QA site as children of page 17 (Poll Roadmap). Environment/content issue, not plugin code.
failures.expected: GET /board-view/ (and the other 4) returns 200 directly per A1's acceptance bar
failures.actual: 301 Moved Permanently -> http://roadmap.local/poll-roadmap/<slug>/ for board-view, timeline-view, list-view, cards-view, minimal-view (poll-roadmap itself, the actual top-level page, returns 200 directly). Following the redirect lands on a working 200 page with correct content.

failures.triage_note: vue-app/src/components/RoadmapHeader.vue declares defineEmits(['update:mode','update:search','toggle-dark-mode','suggest']) but its <template> (29 lines, fully read) only wires update:search, suggest, and update:mode to actual elements - no button/control anywhere emits toggle-dark-mode. vue-app/src/App.vue:297 initializes const darkMode = ref(false) and line 709's toggleDarkMode() (the only place darkMode.value is ever mutated) is only invoked via @toggle-dark-mode="toggleDarkMode" on <RoadmapHeader> - an event that is never dispatched. Confirmed live: no dark/mode/theme/sun/moon button exists in the rendered DOM on board-view (searched all <button>/<a> class, aria-label, and title attributes). Also confirmed BuddyX's own 'dark mode' feature (assets/css/dark-mode.min.css, inc/extra.php:361) is LearnDash-LMS-focus-mode-only, not a general theme toggle, and prefers-color-scheme:dark media emulation had no visual effect on the board (screenshot stayed light).
failures.expected: Per D.5 and D.16, dark mode should be reachable and readable on every board surface
failures.actual: There is currently no way for any visitor, member, or admin to switch a frontend roadmap board into dark mode - the feature is coded but completely disconnected from the UI
